correctness.rationale: Theorem 2.2 of arXiv:1305.5092 exhausts the net lattice types, with 9, 10 or 12 triples and 9, 6 or 0 doubles. Published line equations are checked at (b,c)=(2,3),(2,2) by enumerating every pair. The uniform 9-line/9-mixed-triple graph with t=0,1,3 extra exceptional stars has 18+t vertices, 36 edges, genus 19-t, and minimum valence at least three. Exact Laplacian polynomials, two rooted integer Smith normal forms, determinant prime factorizations and independent prime-local reductions modulo 3^9 and 5^9 agree; all local pivots have valuations below nine. The Neron interpretation is explicitly conditional on regular split semistable unit-thickness reduction under Raynaud Theorem 8.2.

value.rationale: The three complex nine-line (3,3)-net classes are exhaustive and geometrically natural, and the resolved complete line-plus-exceptional boundaries are canonical constructions. Their exact integral Jacobians reveal a sharp loss of all five-primary torsion at the Ceva twelve-triple case, while all three curves have exactly 36 nodes. This is not just a routine order or eigenvalue computation: full Smith invariant factors give the geometric Neron component groups under explicit smoothing assumptions and distinguish the arithmetic lattice information of the three incidence types. No arbitrary numerical slice, general unproved extension or external certification is claimed.
